name: Aegires E2EE
description: End-to-end encryption for Discord on Valenced, compatible with the Aegires Android app. Encrypts and decrypts text messages, images, GIFs, videos, audio and files (up to 1 GiB) with a shared password, using Aegires v2 (Argon2id, AES-GCM). An E2EE button in the chat header switches encryption per chat and decrypted messages get a lock icon. Videos and audio play right in the chat (speed, 10 s jumps, picture-in-picture), with an optional liquid glass look, wallpapers and Aegires color themes. A native module (C Argon2id with Kotlin/Java fallback) makes key derivation much faster than plain JS.
author: Dark (https://github.com/system32crowdstrikewin11 "GitHub")
